annotations.title: Add a service, class or rental

description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Add a new offering to a business the owner already has, live or not, described the same way as in owner_setup. On a live business it can be booked at once. Confirm the details with the owner first; never invent a price. Use it for a service that is not there yet; to change one that exists use owner_update_offering.

business_id.description: The business to add it to: business_id from owner_status

offering.description: The service, class or rental, in the same form as owner_setup's offerings. Prices in major units (2500); duration_min in minutes; price_from: a starting price; quote_only: price on request; rentals: units, deposit; classes: capacity, schedule [{"days":"tue","time":"18:30"}]; options: paid extras.
